rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-26 DUAL-DOMAIN (idea G): FIRST projection-domain lever. PREPEND a zero-init NOISE-ADAPTIVE Manduca proj filter (Manduca 2009 photon/Anscombe variance-stabilising bilateral) to the iter-7 CHAMPION FoE image-domain unroll. sino_filtered = sino + proj_gain*(Manduca(sino)-sino): N=N0*exp(-P) photon counts, Q=sqrt(N) Anscombe variance stabilisation, Qhat=BF(Q) single fixed range sigma (IMPLICITLY noise-adaptive: dense low-count noisy rays smoothed more, scale=learnable log_N0), Nhat=Qhat^2, Phat=-ln(Nhat/N0). ZERO-INIT proj_gain => sino_filtered==sino byte-for-byte => SAME LD-FBP init + SAME DC g => whole pipeline == iter-7 at init (worst case == iter-7, no regression). Filtered sino feeds BOTH the LD-FBP init (recomputed in forward so grads flow to proj params) AND the DC term. FoE image reg UNCHANGED (nf24/k7/nb31, zero-init RBF). +5 params (3 sigma + log_N0 + gain) = 1926 vs iter-7 1921. CAVEAT: proj-domain filtering NEAR-COSMETIC/NEGATIVE STANDALONE on dense full-view Mayo (2304 views -> FBP already averages projection noise; Manduca standalone test hr ~0.069, PWLS ray-weighting NEGATIVE). This iter tests the COMBINATION on the FoE baseline. REALISTIC: modest/NULL (proj_gain->~0, hr~0.2515) confirming dense-view ceiling. Trainer iter-7 byte-for-byte: K=5 tied scalar alpha, no momentum/per-step-alpha, peak lr 5e-3, PARTIAL cosine T_max=16, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, val_n=214, per-sample-ps, grad_clip=1.0, full-view DC. PREDICTED hr ~0.25-0.26 (gain->~0).
